model_system: triple-Q charge density wave on a Kagome lattice model for AV3Sb5 (A = K, Rb, Cs), focusing on imaginary CDW (iCDW) with loop currents

key_params.free_energy: F=sum_alpha (b cos(2 theta_alpha)-lambda1')|Delta_Qalpha|^2 + lambda2 |Delta_Q1||Delta_Q2||Delta_Q3| cos(theta1+theta2+theta3) + u1 sum_alpha |Delta_Qalpha|^4 + u2 sum_{alpha!=beta}|Delta_Qalpha|^2|Delta_Qbeta|^2
key_params.simplification: lambda3=0, C3 symmetry imposed: theta1=theta2=theta3=theta0 and |Delta_Q1|=|Delta_Q2|=|Delta_Q3|
key_params.phase_selection: b>0 => iCDW with theta0=±pi/2; b<0 => rCDW with theta0=0 or pi
key_params.dynamics: L includes kappa0|∂tau Delta_Qalpha|^2 + kappa1|∇Delta_Qalpha|^2 + free-energy terms
key_params.collective_mode_basis: A and E1,E2 irreps for amplitude and phase fluctuations

headline_claim: In the iCDW phase, phase and amplitude modes mix in the A channel, with q=0 mode energies given by kappa0 (omega_pm^(A))^2 = |b| + 2(u1+2u2)|Delta_Q|^2 ± sqrt[(|b|-2(u1+2u2)|Delta_Q|^2)^2 + (9/4)lambda2^2|Delta_Q|^2], whereas they decouple in the rCDW phase.
replication_difficulty: medium - mainly symbolic/algebraic mean-field expansion and mode diagonalization, but some parameter choices and later NV-field modeling are not fully specified in the excerpt.
